lastCompletedStory.title: Add optional type field to the issue schema (both copies) and IssueEntry

nextStoryContext: US-002 (cam spec --persist) should persist an optional type onto IssueEntry when the operator supplies one during the grill. The two schema copies are intentionally NOT byte-identical (scripts/cam/issues.schema.json carries specSource/derivedFrom/allOf blocks that templates/scripts/cam/issues.schema.json lacks); the new 'type' enum property was added independently to each copy's properties block, not synced via allOf. No required-array change was made (type stays optional; default 'feat' is a consumer-side concern for US-004/US-005, not this schema). Remember bun run embed-vendor + embed-vendor:check whenever templates/ changes.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Pure JSON Schema (draft-07) authoring + TS type addition; no runtime schema-validation library (e.g. ajv) is used in this repo to consume issues.schema.json, so no external library API was exercised.
